notes.title: An update on the launch of The Perfect Pencil
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/44f80f1e4a1a487b6fbe300a42290c19a76eafb6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]first of all, we wanted to thank you for the incredible support and enthusiasm you've shown for The Perfect Pencil since its announcement. Reading your comments and seeing your reactions is the biggest motivation for our team.[/p][p]Today, we are sharing an important update on our journey toward launch.[/p][p]With the end of summer, we've taken stock of the development progress and carefully went over the release schedule for the coming months. As you know, our goal has always been to present you with The Perfect Pencil at its the best, in order to offer you an experience you won't forget.[/p][p]The fall release landscape is shaping up to be incredibly packed with fantastic games, many of which we can't wait to play ourselves.[/p][p]For this very reason, and to ensure that The Perfect Pencil meets the highest quality standards and gets the space and attention it deserves, [b]we have made the strategic decision to move the launch window to early 2026[/b].[/p][p]This was not an easy choice for us, but we believe that it is the best one for our game and for you, our community.[/p][p]The extra time gives us a valuable opportunity: it will allow us not only to polish the game, but to also [b]integrate at launch new features and content that we had originally planned for the post-launch support[/b]. The result will be a richer and more complete game for you to enjoy from day one.[/p][p]Thank you again for your patience and understanding. We really believe that we are creating something special, and we can't wait to show you![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858810/The_Perfect_Pencil/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Perfect Pencil Joins Steam Next Fest – Play the Updated Demo!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Big news! The Perfect Pencil is officially part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest, and we’ve got a brand-new demo packed with fresh content and improvements, [b]out now[/b]! 🎉

[h2]🔍 What’s New in the Demo?
[/h2]

✅ A brand-new boss fight – Accessible directly from the main menu.
✅ Polished gameplay & refinements – Based on your feedback, we’ve improved the overall experience.
✅ Two hours of surreal adventure – Explore The Soft Forest, the game’s eerie and mysterious first area.

Steam Next Fest is the perfect time to dive into The Perfect Pencil and get a glimpse of what awaits you!

[h2]ICYMI: Watch our latest trailer
[/h2]

[previewyoutube=0WEjRjm9-xg;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]💬 Join Our Community![/h2]

We’d love for you to help us improve The Perfect Pencil! If you encounter any bugs, issues, or anything that feels off, let us know. Your feedback is incredibly valuable in making the game the best it can be.

➡️ [url=https://discord.gg/MY3p3PKTap]Join Our Discord[/url]

Even if you just want to share your thoughts on the experience, we’d love to hear them! Join our Discord or leave a comment: we're excited to chat with you.



[h2]🔔Wishlist The Perfect Pencil now and stay tuned for more updates![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858810/The_Perfect_Pencil/

notes.title: The Healing Attack - Dev Blog #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to our second development update!

Today we want to introduce you to one of the most important features of the game: [b]The Healing Attack[/b].

This is the mechanism that allows you to regain “[b]Will[/b]” (health points) on the course of your adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/071ad736b6a64d6cfb7e3505fc5503e487815166.gif[/img]

The Healing Attack derived directly from the psychological narrative behind the game, and it is the perfect example of [b]how we are trying to create a cohesive structure[/b] that binds narrative and gameplay together as much as possible.

This is done in order to craft a complete experience through the tools offered by the video game medium.


[h2]The process behind this special attack can ne divided in two steps.
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/962373685604ba6faf0096707d1feec0416042fe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/bed665aa84f661c3fb70e2ab12993eab26036a53.gif[/img]

First the players will have to confront the enemies directly by attacking them. This will allow them to gather “[b]Courage[/b]” (energy).

This is a clear reference to the core meaning of the game: confronting obstacles to overcome them and proceed on your journey.

Once you have gathered enough “[b]Courage[/b]” (energy), you’ll be able to transform it into “[b]Will[/b]” (health points).

This is done by charging the Healing Attack and - once the charge phase is completed and the attack is still charged - landing the next blow on an enemy.

This is another instance where the narrative of the game shines through: you have the power to transform your Courage, through action, into Will.  It is said Will that is necessary to keep you standing in the face of adversities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/eb46102e9e04d83244c5616ef2780ad3cf714448.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/ee9f661fad2c9217fc03b27982165b385588874f.png[/img]

A small detail that you might find significant is the fact that you’ll be able to gain “[b]Will[/b]” (health points) regardless of [b]whether the enemy might be parrying or not[/b]. From a narrative standpoint you are not gaining from their loss, but from the act itself of confronting difficulties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/9b9eee78673f0c68e7ac8a8b2844692213550d4a.gif[/img]

We believe that this ability will make for a very entertaining gameplay and it will keep players on edge: players will be able to regain health only by exposing themselves to danger when they are at their most vulnerable.  When their Will is low, they need Courage to overcome, survive and continue their journey.

[h2]A hidden game mechanic:
[/h2]
There is further use for this ability. What happens if you haven’t taken any damage, and you try the Healing Attack when your halth bar is full? This will unleash a more powerful blow that will deal more damage to your enemies and will allow you to defeat them more easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41890985/9949d63c96d07440585205faa50a333da96bacc9.gif[/img]

[h2]About Us
[/h2]The team was born in 2019 and it has slowly grown since then. It is now composed by 10 people: programmers, artists, game designers, a social media manager and a psychologist. Plus an external studio for musics and sound design.

We are all based in Italy, and we love what we are doing!

[h2]If you want to try The Perfect Pencil & support us...
[/h2]
You can download the demo and play it right now! It works also on Steam Deck!

If you want to support us just wishlist and follow the game page in Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858810/The_Perfect_Pencil/
